identified_issues: Violation of Storage Cluster Security & Operations Standard Section 8.4 prerequisite requirements: block stream synchronization executed while 14 client write handles remained actively connected.
Execution proceeded despite an aborted node drain and unverified in-memory dirty write buffers, creating severe risk of transactional journal desynchronization and volume corruption.
The proposal to mark the operation as PASS based solely on administrative RBAC authorization ignores explicit operational safety prerequisite violations.
evidence: Node supervisor drain log at 2026-10-06T02:00:08.410Z records: 'Drain timeout after 8s: 14 client connections pinned by open write transactions. Drain aborted.'
Node supervisor state log at 2026-10-06T02:00:08.420Z records: 'Node remains non-quiescent: 14 active client write handles connected.'

Target check log at 2026-10-06T02:00:15.050Z confirms: 'Querying STOR_NODE_06 status: 14 active client handles; dirty buffers unverified.' immediately prior to executing CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM at 02:00:15.100Z.
recommended_action: Do not clear the security alert or validate the operation as PASS. Immediately isolate STOR_NODE_06 from client traffic, run an offline storage integrity and journal consistency check on the affected volume, and update the orchestration workflow to enforce mandatory hard aborts on CMD_SYNC_BLOCK_STREAM if active client handles exceed zero or drain operations fail.
